activity.notes: After the office was retitled Head of the Republic in October 2005, Ilyumzhinov continued as Kalmykia's highest executive until 24 October 2010. ATLAS retains Kalmykia as a distinct ethnic-federal political community rather than reducing this Activity to generic Russian regional administration.

sources.title: Kirsan Ilyumzhinov — Biography
sources.citation_text: The biography records Ilyumzhinov's leadership of the Republic of Kalmykia through October 2010.

sources.title: Head of the Republic of Kalmykia — office chronology
sources.citation_text: Office chronologies record Ilyumzhinov's title change to Head of the Republic in 2005 and departure on 24 October 2010.
